description: SEAMA - LAGESA - PERS-2019 - RESÍDUOS SÓLIDOS URBANOS - RSU is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). O Plano Estadual de Resíduos Sólidos do Espírito Santo (PERS-ES) é um instrumento da Política Estadual de Resíduos Sólidos, conforme preconiza a Lei Estadual n.º 9.264/2009. Sua elaboração descreve não só os elementos de gestão, como também do gerenciamento dos resíduos gerados ou administrados nos limites de suas circunscrições. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are ES, features, PERS-2019, rsu, RSU. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
